messages.text: I am having trouble getting on to Harlo Pool.

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist, and I'll help you get connected to Harlo Pool.

To start, I need to know what's going wrong:

1. **Which miner** are you connecting? For example a Harlo B30, Bitaxe, NerdQX or Hammer. If you know the firmware version, tell me that too.
2. **What do you mean by "getting on"?**
   - Is it the Harlo Pool **website or dashboard** that won't load or log you in?
   - Or is it the **miner** that won't connect or hash on the pool after you entered the pool settings?
3. **What do you see?** Tell me any error message or status, like "disconnected", "connecting" or 0 hashrate. A screenshot of the miner's pool settings page or the error is ideal.

Once I have that, I'll walk you through the fix one step at a time.
I am trying to connect my Nexus S1 and cant seem to add my BCH address to the pool.
Searched the web · Harlo Pool BCH address worker setup
Searched the web · Nexus S1 miner pool setup BCH

Got it, thanks. Your N. S1 can mine on Harlo Pool. 
It's a 0% fee Bitcoin Cash mining pool
, and 
the NEXUS S1 is a home Bitcoin miner delivering ~10 TH/s at ~150W
, which is the same SHA-256 algorithm.

The B. address goes in two places, so first I need to know which one is giving you trouble.

**A. The miner's pool settings** (the Nexus S1 web page). Harlo Pool's setup page says to use:
- Pool URL: `stratum+tcp://pool.harlolabs.com:8888`
- Worker: your BCH address
- Password: `x`

**B. The pool website.** 
Log in at pool.harlolabs.com with your email and link your BCH wallet.
 That is what credits your free spins.

**Which one fails, A or B? And what happens when you try?** For example, does the field cut the address short, does it say "invalid", or does it save but nothing shows up on the pool? A screenshot would help a lot.

One quick thing to check while you look: BCH addresses often start with `bitcoincash:q...`. If the field won't take the full address, try pasting it without the `bitcoincash:` part, so it starts with `q`. That's a common snag, but I haven't confirmed it's the cause on the S1, so please tell me what you see.
I am using a Coinbase address starting with 1Dfo

Thanks, that helps. An address starting with `1` is an older "legacy" format, so first we need to make sure it's the right coin.

**Important:** Bitcoin (BTC) addresses also start with `1`. If that address came from Coinbase's **Bitcoin** receive screen and not its **Bitcoin Cash** one, BCH mined to it may never show up in your Coinbase account. So before anything else:

1. In Coinbase, open **Bitcoin Cash (BCH)** and tap **Receive**.
2. Check that the address shown there is the one starting `····`.

**Does it match the BCH receive address?** And when you try to add it, where does it fail: in the Nexus S1's pool settings, or when linking the wallet on pool.harlolabs.com? Tell me what message you get, if any.

I tried to check which address formats Harlo Pool accepts, but I couldn't open the pool site from here. If the BCH address is right and it still gets rejected, the next step is to see whether the pool wants the newer `bitcoincash:q...` format, and we'll do that together.
first, I generated a new BCH address which starts with ····. the failure happens when I attempt to add my address to the pool. It's as if the pool doesn't take it
Searched the web · convert BCH legacy address to cashaddr
Handed to the team · Can't open pool.harlolabs.com from here to check which address formats it accept

Thanks. A fresh address from Coinbase's BCH receive screen is the right source, so the coin is fine. The problem is most likely the **format**:

- Your address starting with `1` is the old "legacy" format. **Legacy addresses (1xxx, 3xxx) work on both Bitcoin and BCH, so they're ambiguous.**
- BCH's own format is **CashAddr (bitcoincash:qxxx)**. Many BCH services expect that one.
- Both formats point to the **same wallet**. Only the way it's written changes.

I can't open the pool site from here, so I can't confirm it only accepts CashAddr. Here's what to try:

1. Get the CashAddr version of your Coinbase BCH address. It will start with `bitcoincash:q`.
2. Paste it into the pool's wallet field. If it's refused, try again without the `bitcoincash:` part, starting at `q`.
3. If it still fails, send me a screenshot or the exact error the pool shows.

I've also passed this to JD, our hardware lead, so he can check exactly which format Harlo Pool expects. **Please stay in this chat.** Someone from the team will join here, and if you step away you'll get the answer by email. For a faster reply, you can also ask in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and mention **@nullhashrate** (JD). He's very active there.

You're welcome! While you wait, you can still set up the miner itself. Put the pool URL, your BCH address as the worker and `x` as the password into the Nexus S1's pool settings, then let it run.

If you get the CashAddr version working on the pool site, or you see an error message, just post it here.
